content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Understanding Data Analysis and its Importance
    - Lesson 2: Overview of Data Analyst Roles and Responsibilities
    - Lesson 3: Setting Up Your Data Analysis Environment
    - Lesson 4: Basic Statistics for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Excel for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 6: Intermediate Excel Functions and Formulas
    - Lesson 7: Power BI Overview and Data Visualization Basics
    - Lesson 8: Querying Data with Power Query in Power BI

   Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: SQL WHERE Clause and Filtering Data
    - Lesson 4: SQL JOIN Operations
    - Lesson 5: Working with NULL Values in SQL
    - Lesson 6: Aggregate Functions in SQL
    - Lesson 7: Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 8: Advanced SQL Concepts (UNION, DISTINCT, LIMIT, OFFSET)

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and NumPy
    - Lesson 2: Working with CSV Files in Python
    - Lesson 3: Intermediate Python Functions (map, filter, reduce)
    - Lesson 4: Pandas Basics (Data Structures and Manipulation)
    - Lesson 5: Data Cleaning Techniques with Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Grouping and Aggregating Data with Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Merging and Joining DataFrames in Pandas
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Matplotlib for Data Visualization

   Track: Intermediate Python and Pandas
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Indexing, Selection, and Alignment
    - Lesson 2: Dealing with Missing Values using forward fill, backfill, and interpolate
    - Lesson 3: Data Aggregation and Groupby Advanced Concepts (pivot_table, crosstab)
    - Lesson 4: Time Series Analysis using Pandas Timedeltas
    - Lesson 5: Reshaping Data with Melt and Stack
    - Lesson 6: Reading and Writing to Databases using SQLite
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Seaborn for Advanced Data Visualization
    - Lesson 8: Building Data Pipelines in Python

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Handling Duplicate Rows and Removing them
    - Lesson 2: Filling Missing Values using Median, Mean or Mode Imputation
    - Lesson 3: Dealing with Outliers in Data
    - Lesson 4: One-Hot Encoding and Feature Engineering
    - Lesson 5: Handling Categorical Data with LabelEncoder and OrdinalEncoder
    - Lesson 6: Splitting Data into Training, Validation, and Test Sets
    - Lesson 7: Scaling and Normalizing Numerical Data
    - Lesson 8: Balancing Imbalanced Datasets

   Track: Introduction to Data Analysis Tools (Tableau/Looker/Power BI)
    - Lesson 1: Overview of Tableau, Looker and Power BI
    - Lesson 2: Connecting to Your Datasource in Tableau/Looker/Power BI
    - Lesson 3: Creating Basic Visualizations in Tableau/Looker/Power BI
    - Lesson 4: Intermediate Data Visualization Techniques (Dashboards, Storytelling)
    - Lesson 5: Advanced Data Visualization Techniques (Maps, Trendlines)
    - Lesson 6: Building Custom Visualizations in Tableau/Looker/Power BI
    - Lesson 7: Sharing and Publishing Your Reports
    - Lesson 8: Best Practices for Data Storytelling
